mapping.notes: M20 Bone to Ash's first sentence (verified record), word for word. The probe board has no spell on the stack. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/essence_scatter_*.json.

clauses.evidence: The probe's only line is 'cast skipped: a target slot needs 1, the board offers 0': no spell is ever on the stack. The tree reads right (COUNTER_SPELL, one TARGET over the stack, FAnd(STACK_KIND_EQ SPELL, TYPE_EQ Creature)). Covered by packs: A10_1 (a creature spell is countered: graveyard, never enters), A10_3 (two creature spells wait on the stack, only the targeted one is countered), A10_2 (a noncreature spell is refused and resolves), A10_4 (a creature's ability on the stack is not a spell: refused).
